_comment: Allowlist for scripts/verify-readme.js. Each entry is a string shaped like a path that the script extracts from README.md or CONTRIBUTING.md but that we intentionally do not want to fail the build. Keep entries alphabetised and add a trailing /*comment* style key in '_note' sub-objects when the rationale is non-obvious.

_notes.Backdoor/: Directory-tree header label, not a real folder
_notes.build/: README explicitly states there is no dist/ or build/ directory
_notes.customers/: Firestore collection name from the data model section, not a path
_notes.dist/: README explicitly states there is no dist/ or build/ directory
_notes.functions/: Tree-viz fragment of 'netlify/functions/' that the regex strips
_notes.netlify/functions: Bare reference missing the trailing slash from the tree visualisation
_notes.sgscrap/BackdoorCo: GitHub org/repo shape used in the clone URL example
_notes..env / .env.local / .env.local.example: Gitignored secrets file (template) — these are not committed
_notes.admin/: Tree header; the script already resolves most paths under admin/ via RESOLUTION_PREFIXES
_notes.admin/seed-html: Family of admin/seed-*.html pagers; the script's regex extracts the bare 'seed-html' token
_notes.admin/restock-private.local.json: Per-machine file used by the Restock Desk; gitignored
_notes.brand-logos/: Future folder; not yet committed but referenced in README
_notes.css/: Header in the directory layout that lists css files individually
_notes.products/: Future folder; image uploads go to server.js but the dir is populated at runtime
_notes.products/catalog/uploads.json: Registry written by the local mirror upload server (--serve) on the first upload
_notes.restock_ideas/: Firestore collection name from the Restock Desk section, not a path
_notes._shared/: Inside netlify/functions/, the script tries the bare reference then falls back via RESOLUTION_PREFIXES
_notes..github/: Workflow folder; the script surfaces .github/workflows/codeql*.yml directly
_notes.public/ / paypal-checkout-public/: Firebase public-only mirror used by paypal-checkout.js, not a project path
